description: Prepare one or more bounded stETH withdrawal requests with an exact queue approval and cleanup. This irreversible asynchronous action mints unstETH NFTs, stops rewards while queued, and can settle below 1:1 after extraordinary losses; wallet simulation and clear user review are required.

amounts.description: One to 64 stETH request amounts, each from 100 wei through 1000 stETH

owner.description: Recipient/owner of the unstETH request NFTs; defaults to sender (address)

name: prepare_lido_withdrawal_request
title: Prepare a Lido withdrawal request
